name: finishing-a-development-branch-checklist
description: Verify finishing-a-development-branch skill runs the pre-completion checklist — including the strict-greenfield map checkpoint before artifact cleanup — and presents the three disposal options without auto-merging.
input: I've finished all tasks on branch feat/kyau-abc123-add-login. All plan tasks are checked off. Verify the branch is ready and tell me my options.
expected_behavior: Agent runs each checklist item — working tree, rebase state, /check, @code-review
Agent does not skip any checklist item
If any item fails, agent stops and reports the failure without presenting options

For strict-greenfield bootstrap branches, agent requires successful /check and @code-review, derives the immutable bootstrap-spec link, and directs the user to a fresh wayfinder session before cleanup
Agent confirms the wayfinder map exists with the immutable URL in its Notes before deleting plan/spec artifacts; otherwise halts without cleanup
If all items pass, agent presents the summary block with exactly 3 numbered options (prepare PR via /pr, keep, discard)
Agent does NOT propose git push
Agent does NOT auto-merge — waits for user response
